description: Source code for ALSA mixer control interface in Android, including functions for opening, closing, dumping, and manipulating mixer controls via ioctl calls.

classes.name: mixer
classes.description: Represents an ALSA mixer device, manages file descriptor and controls.

classes.name: mixer_ctl
classes.description: Represents a control element within the mixer, including info and name array.

methods.name: elem_iface_name
methods.description: Returns string name for a given control interface type.

methods.name: elem_type_name
methods.description: Returns string name for a given control element type.

methods.name: mixer_close
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with a mixer.

methods.name: mixer_open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the ALSA mixer device, retrieving control info.

methods.name: mixer_dump
methods.description: Prints detailed info about all controls in the mixer.

methods.name: mixer_get_control
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control by name and index.

methods.name: mixer_get_nth_control
methods.description: Retrieves the nth control in the mixer.

methods.name: mixer_ctl_print
methods.description: Prints the current value of a control.

methods.name: mixer_ctl_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a control based on a percentage.

methods.name: mixer_ctl_select
methods.description: Selects an enumerated control value by name.
